L2: ## Treatment for canine hemangiosarcoma (HSA) of the spleen.
L3: 
L4: ### Study details.
L5: 
L6: Qualified patients in this fully-funded study (all diagnostics, treatment, and exams) will receive 4 doses of Paccal Vet® chemotherapy and will be monitored for up to 12 months following spleen removal.
L7: ### Inclusion criteria:
L8: 
L9:   * Dogs diagnosed with stage I or stage II splenic HSA
L10: 
L11:   * Eligible to receive first dose of Paccal Vet therapy within 30 days of spleen removal
L12: 
L13:   * Owner consent to enrollment in the study and ability to comply with the protocol visit schedule
L14: ### Exclusion criteria:
L15:   * Dogs that have previously received chemotherapy
L16:   * Dogs that have an active systemic infection
L17:   * Any other disease state that requires medications prohibited by the study
L18:   * Dogs that are pregnant, lactating, or intended for breeding during the study period
L19:   * Dogs currently enrolled in another therapeutic clinical study
L20:   * No clinically significant abnormalities on lab work
L21:   * Known Multidrug Resistant 1 gene (MDR1) mutation (mut/wt or mut/mut)
L22:     * For any dog considered by the Investigator to be at high risk of carrying an MDR1 mutation (e.g. Standard Collie, Long-haired Whippet, or Australian Shepherd [standard and miniature]), MDR1 testing will be performed prior to enrollment. If an MDR1 mutation is detected, the patient will be excluded
L23:   * Any other reason which, according to the Investigator, would affect the safety of the dog or severely interfere with study procedures
L24: ### Locations and contacts:
L25: 
L26:   * 【1†Kirkland, WA】: Kevin Choy, BVSc, DACVIM, at 425.823.9111
L27:   * 【2†Tacoma, WA】: Sharon Shor, DVM, DACVIM; Sarah Broom, DVM, DACVIM (Oncology); at 253.474.0791
L28: 
L29: ### Duration of study.
L30: 
L31: Patient participation will be up to 12 months. The study will be active until 2026.
L32: 
L33: ### Covered costs.
L34: 
L35: All study-related costs are covered by the sponsor.
